subject: general
question: Four friends K, L, M and N are playing on the playground. L is standing towards the east of K and is towards the north of M. M is standing towards the west of N's house. In which direction is N standing from K?
solution:
Given: Four friends K, L, M and N are playing on the playground.

1) L is standing towards the east of K and is towards the north of M.

2) M is standing towards the west of N's house.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9575b77926948e429413cf751cf691a7276df1ce9ca4a1197a6357e47a3d38d1.png] 

So, N is standing at the '**South-east**' from K.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
